normalization_plan.reason: sender is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by the internal transfer function
recipient is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by the internal transfer function
amount is a transient transfer argument fully consumed by the internal transfer function
amountReceived is a temporary local produced and consumed inside the transfer function
shareholder parameter is only used to look up and pay the dividend within distributeDividend
dividend amount local is a transient value used only for the payout inside distributeDividend
amountToSwap is a temporary value consumed by the swap logic in swapBack
the path array is constructed solely as an argument to the external router swap call
feeAmount is a transient computation local to takeFee
amount parameter is only used to compute the fee inside takeFee
_address parameter is only used to set the bot blacklist entry in setBot
bots_ array is only iterated to update the blacklist in setBulkBots/delBulkBots
